name: jql
description: Rust-based JSON Query Language with Lisp-like syntax and streaming support - designed for step-by-step JSON transformation with intuitive token-based queries

jql.description: JSON Query Language with Lisp-like syntax and streaming support for Docker logs and real-time JSON processing - intuitive token-based queries for complex transformations
jql.usage:
jql '.["users"].[0].["name"]' data.json
jql --stream '.["message"]' # Stream processing for Docker logs
echo '{"items":[1,2,3]}' | jql '.["items"] | flatten'
jql '.["logs"] | select(.["level"] == "error") | .["message"]' app.json
jql --help # Show Lisp-like syntax examples
